fields.name: live_work_area
fields.meaning: Live working memory kept in cartridge RAM (map units, pilot and robot tables while playing); not protected by any check. Saving copies parts of it into the save blocks and loading copies them back
fields.evidence: changes during play without saving; save code copies from 0x0EC9, 0x1515, 0x2151, 0x24D1, 0x2CFC, 0x3053, 0x33D3 (d000:a7aa/d000:aa24)

fields.name: magic
fields.meaning: Format mark 0x007B; checked at every power-on together with its mirror at 0x742A. If either is wrong the whole save area is re-formatted and all saves are lost
fields.evidence: code d000:b258 compares 0x33E7 with 0x742A and 0x7B; d000:b2fa writes

fields.name: global_checksum
fields.meaning: 16-bit sum of little-endian words from 0x33EB to 0x741A (covers every slot and record); copy at 0x742C must match too
fields.evidence: code d000:b3c2 and c000:7230; recomputed over all 111 save images

fields.name: s0.funds
fields.meaning: Money, capped at 9,999,999. Slot 0 is the map (mid-battle) save
fields.evidence: code f000:9818 adds with cap 0x98967F; save screenshot shows 0

fields.name: s0.funds_total
fields.meaning: Running total of money earned over the game (map earnings added when each map ends)
fields.evidence: code f000:cd81/f000:ce35 (total += funds - funds_at_map_start)

fields.name: s0.funds_at_map_start
fields.meaning: Money at the start of the current map, used to work out what was earned on it (map save only)
fields.evidence: code d000:3a09 sets it from funds at map start

fields.name: s0.turn
fields.meaning: Turn counter of the current map, counted from 0 (screen shows turn = value + 1)
fields.evidence: code f000:ce72 increments it; value 0 while screen shows turn 1

fields.name: s0.map_state
fields.meaning: Map state bits; loading sets bit 0x0400 in addition
fields.evidence: code d000:a7c1 saves, d000:ad45 restores and ORs 0x400; value 0x1000

fields.name: s0.var_242
fields.meaning: Map word of unknown meaning (0 in the map save)
fields.evidence: code d000:a7c6 saves from IRAM 0x242, d000:ad4c restores

fields.name: s0.map_event_flags
fields.meaning: Event flags for the current map; cleared when a map ends
fields.evidence: code d000:a818 copies 32 bytes from IRAM 0x08DC; f000:cde4/f000:ce79 clear them

fields.name: s0.cursor_row
fields.meaning: Map cursor row
fields.evidence: code d000:a7d6 stores IRAM 0x2FC here

fields.name: s0.cursor_col
fields.meaning: Map cursor column (0x19, then 0x1B after moving right twice and saving again)
fields.evidence: two saves differing only in this byte plus checksums; code d000:a7d6

fields.name: s0.map_vars_17b
fields.meaning: Six map words of unknown meaning (all 0; cleared at new game)
fields.evidence: code d000:a7df saves from IRAM 0x17B-0x186, d000:98a8 clears

fields.name: s0.counter_240
fields.meaning: Story counter that new game sets to 0 and map-end code increases only when already nonzero
fields.evidence: code d000:9882 clears, d000:3a04 increments, d000:aa77 saves

fields.name: s0.story_progress
fields.meaning: Scenario progress bytes; the first byte selects the next scenario through a route table (all 0 = first map)
fields.evidence: code f000:ce94 indexes a scenario table with byte 0

fields.name: s0.tag
fields.meaning: 16 bytes of letter-code text reading WONDERSWANCOLOR; purpose unknown
fields.evidence: all 15 bytes fit 0x0B+(c-'A') plus NUL; saved from IRAM 0x93B by d000:aaa5

fields.name: s0.var_94b
fields.meaning: Story/system word of unknown meaning
fields.evidence: code d000:aae2 saves from IRAM 0x94B

fields.name: s0.vars_94d
fields.meaning: Four story/system bytes of unknown meaning
fields.evidence: code d000:aaf3-ab26 saves from IRAM 0x94D-0x950

fields.name: s0.map_units
fields.meaning: 54 records of 58 bytes: the units on the current map, both sides (map save only)
fields.evidence: code d000:a85b loop, record address f000:5aec (0x1515 + n*0x3A); restored by d000:add6

fields.name: s0.map_pilots
fields.meaning: 64 records of 14 bytes: pilot state on the map: +0 side flag?, +2 pilot number, +4 experience (24-bit), +7 is 100 on live records (map save only)
fields.evidence: code d000:a9b0 loop, f000:5b66 (0x2151 + n*0x0E); pilot numbers/experience match the roster

fields.name: s0.robot_roster
fields.meaning: 96 records of 17 bytes: the robot list: +0 active flag, +1 robot number, +2 current form, +10 pilot aboard, +11..+15 combine partners (0xFF none), +16 always 1
fields.evidence: code d000:ab4e loop, f000:5b32 (0x24D1 + n*0x11); all 8 owned robots match pilots sitting in them

fields.name: s0.gap1
fields.meaning: Never written (zero), but inside the checksum
fields.evidence: address gap between table writes in d000:aa24

fields.name: s0.pilot_roster
fields.meaning: 80 records of 9 bytes: the pilot list: +0 flags (bit 0 tested for team), +1 robot occupied (0xFFFF none), +3 pilot number, +4 experience (24-bit), +8 group mask
fields.evidence: code d000:abf9 loop, f000:5b92 (0x2CFC + n*9); team check c000:70e3; 10 pilots aboard match robots

fields.name: s0.gap2
fields.meaning: Never written (zero), but inside the checksum
fields.evidence: address gap between table writes in d000:aa24

fields.name: s0.table_3053
fields.meaning: 448 words copied from work memory; values use the high byte only (205 nonzero); probably per-unit stat data
fields.evidence: code d000:ac5b loop, f000:5baa; new-game fill d000:983a

fields.name: s0.table_33d3
fields.meaning: 20 bytes copied from work memory (all zero in the map save)
fields.evidence: code d000:ac94 loop, f000:5bc0; init d000:9865

fields.name: s0.table_0ec9
fields.meaning: 136 bytes copied from work memory (all zero in the map save)
fields.evidence: code d000:acbb from SRAM 0x0EC9

fields.name: s0.team_mask
fields.meaning: Active pilot-group mask; pilots whose group byte shares a bit with this count as in the team (0xFF in the map save). Covered by the global checksum only, not the slot sum
fields.evidence: code c000:70fa tests pilot +8 against IRAM 0x960; past the slot-sum range

fields.name: s0.var_1e1
fields.meaning: Work word of unknown meaning (0x0FFF in the map save). Covered by the global checksum only
fields.evidence: code d000:aad1 saves from IRAM 0x1E1

fields.name: s0.mark
fields.meaning: Slot mark: 0x007B = holds a save, 0xFFFF = empty
fields.evidence: code d000:acf1 writes 0x7B, d000:b2d7 empties; empty before saving, 0x7B after

fields.name: s0.checksum
fields.meaning: 16-bit word sum of 0x33EB-0x53BA
fields.evidence: code d000:b3c2; recomputed on map saves

fields.name: s1.data
fields.meaning: Between-map save slot 1. Same field order as slot 0 without the map-only parts (funds, totals, counter, story, tag, words, robots, pilots, tables, team mask). Empty in every played image
fields.evidence: slot tables d000:a72c-a78e entries verified against ROM; written by d000:aa24(1)

fields.name: s1.mark
fields.meaning: Slot 1 mark (0x007B used, 0xFFFF empty)
fields.evidence: code tables d000:a710

fields.name: s1.checksum
fields.meaning: Word sum of 0x53C4-0x63A3
fields.evidence: code d000:b3c2

fields.name: s2.data
fields.meaning: Between-map save slot 2, same layout as slot 1
fields.evidence: slot tables d000:a72c-a78e entries verified against ROM; written by d000:aa24(2)

fields.name: s2.mark
fields.meaning: Slot 2 mark
fields.evidence: code tables d000:a710

fields.name: s2.checksum
fields.meaning: Word sum of 0x63A9-0x7388
fields.evidence: code d000:b3c2

fields.name: record0
fields.meaning: Extra data record 0: 35 bytes of unknown game data (26 from work memory 0x0EFF, 9 from IRAM 0x0926), then used/empty mark and checksum
fields.evidence: code c000:72b8 writes, c000:7230 checksums, c000:71ce validates; all empty in played images

fields.name: record1
fields.meaning: Extra data record 1, same structure as record 0
fields.evidence: code c000:72b8/c000:7230/c000:71ce with index 1

fields.name: record2
fields.meaning: Extra data record 2, same structure as record 0
fields.evidence: code c000:72b8/c000:7230/c000:71ce with index 2

fields.name: record3
fields.meaning: Extra data record 3, same structure as record 0
fields.evidence: code c000:72b8/c000:7230/c000:71ce with index 3

fields.name: magic_copy
fields.meaning: Mirror of the format mark 0x007B
fields.evidence: code d000:b258

fields.name: global_checksum_copy
fields.meaning: Mirror of the global checksum

fields.name: unused
fields.meaning: Never written (zero)
fields.evidence: all played images zero here

fields.name: not_used
fields.meaning: The console internal memory is not used for saving
fields.evidence: identical in blank and saved images
